description: The asmnet template with --test-runner vstest, for repositories whose tests run on VSTest: its tests run with a plain dotnet test and no global.json entry, as xunit's own template's VSTest choice does. The name has a hyphen, so each of the template's names is checked in its form: my-app.Native for files, paths and the library .NET loads, my_app.Tests for the C# namespace. The folder's own global.json, Directory.Build.props and Directory.Packages.props stand for a user's fresh folder (empty, but for NuGet's audit, which is off).

steps.description: Installs the templates under test from the local feed, into this scenario's own CLI home.
The VSTest choice: Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, xunit.runner.visualstudio and xunit.v3.mtp-off, and global.json left alone.
VSTest runs the five tests against the library built for this machine (libmy-app.Native.so, my-app.Native.dll, ...).
